title: 午前二時のタンゴ
caption: 1960s Japanese kayo tango, dramatic and dangerous, film noir mood. A passionate, dark-toned female vocalist singing in Japanese with theatrical intensity and a strong vibrato. Stabbing tango rhythm from a bandoneon and piano, a weeping solo violin, upright bass, castanets and snare rolls, a string section swelling in the chorus. Seductive, bitter, a femme fatale dancing with the man who betrayed her. Vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
lyrics:
